pages.text: Removes one element from an array or a hash.

Use $(1)index$() for an array and $(1)key$() for a hash. The following array elements move down by one. A missing index raises INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS, a missing key raises UNKNOWN_KEY. Leaving out $(1)index$() or $(1)key$() raises INVALID_ARGUMENT.

$(li)$(1)container$() ARRAY|HASH: the array or hash$(li)$(1)index$() INTEGER: position of the element to remove (optional, needed for arrays)$(li)$(1)key$() STRING: key of the element to remove (optional, needed for hashes)$(li)result $(1)result$() like $(1)container$(): the array or hash without the element
$(1)CALL REMOVE$(br)  PARAMETER container list ;$(br)  PARAMETER index 1 ;$(br)  RESULT result list$()
